era: 轴心时代比较研究 / Axial-Age Comparative Study (前551-前399)
historical_significance: 孔子（前551-前479）与苏格拉底（前469-前399）是轴心时代东西方同时出现的两位'不著书立说的教师'：皆以对话为主要方法、以弟子共同体为传承介质、以本人生命为命题抵押。孔门弟子辑《论语》，柏拉图著《对话篇》，两种相反的记录策略使同一类型的口头哲学各自成为世界级文本。两人共享的深层结构——诘问即检验、定义即处方、美德即知识、学思双引擎、创始人自付代价——构成'轴心突围'的可比较方法论母体；其差异（礼之外置法轨、定义的形而上学走向、记录干预度）则标定两大文明此后制度与哲学的分岔点。本档案以'对照'为方法单位：每个模式都是一次双人实验。
unique_thinking: 本档案的独特性在于把'比较'本身做成方法：十个模式都不是孔子或苏格拉底单人的模式，而是两人对话所逼出的结构性模式——每个模式都含对照面（诘合法的东西两种语气、礼与法两种秩序内核、辑录与创作两种记录工程）。孔子一侧的独特签名：'时中'（原则随语境重述而不失其锚）、'因材施教'（定义即处方）、'学思互证'（输入配省察的双账本）。苏格拉底一侧的独特签名：诘问至aporia的纯检验引擎、定义逼挤的对抗性迭代、以死为法律命题作保。共同签名：'自知无知'与'知之为知之'的认知诚实、'美德即知识'的伦理认知化、创始人自付代价的信用抵押。两人死后八十年与四百年，其思想分别兑换为学园千年与汉代国教——突围投资的世代回报周期是本档案最刺目的审计结论。

modes.name_en: The Elenctic-Dialogue Method: Truth Forged in Questioned Conversation
modes.definition_zh: 孔子与苏格拉底共享的元命题：真理不由权威宣告，而在问对中被逼出。方法论签名有四：其一，以对话为论证的唯一载体——两人皆不著书立说（孔子'述而不作'，苏格拉底一字不写），思想全部由弟子的对话录（《论语》《对话篇》）传世；其二，诘问即检验——苏格拉底以反诘揭穿对话者未经检验的确信（'未经省察的人生不值得过'），孔子以'叩其两端'逼出弟子立场的盲区；其三，承认无知为起点——苏格拉底的'我自知无知'与孔子的'知之为知之，不知为不知，是知也'同构，把诚实标注认知边界设为求真前提；其四，对话者即方法——诘问的锋芒针对具体的人、具体的答案，抽象原则从不脱离具体语境成立。这一模式把'真理'从命题属性改写为过程属性：一个判断成立，是因为它在对抗性问对中幸存，而非因为它出自更高的权威。
modes.definition_en: Confucius and Socrates share one master proposition: truth is not proclaimed by authority but forced out in questioned conversation. Four signatures define the mode. First, dialogue as the sole vehicle of argument — neither wrote treatises (Confucius 'transmitted but did not compose'; Socrates wrote nothing), both surviving only through disciples' recorded conversations (the Analects, the Dialogues). Second, interrogation as testing: Socrates' cross-examination stripped unexamined confidence from his interlocutors ('the unexamined life is not worth living'), while Confucius 'knocked on both ends' to expose the blind spots in a disciple's position. Third, acknowledged ignorance as the starting point: Socrates' 'I know that I know nothing' is isomorphic with Confucius' 'to know what you know and to know what you do not know — that is knowledge'; both make honest marking of cognitive limits the precondition of inquiry. Fourth, the interlocutor is the method: the point of questioning is always a concrete person giving a concrete answer; abstract principles never stand apart from context. The mode rewrites 'truth' from a property of propositions into a property of process: a claim holds because it survived adversarial questioning, not because a higher authority vouched for it.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语·为政》'知之为知之'、'学而不思则罔'；柏拉图《申辩篇》21a-d 神谕与'自知无知'、《美诺篇》诘问奴隶童子
process_zh: 凡关键判断，先构造最强反诘再允许其成立；未经对抗性质询的结论不得进入决策
把'我不知道'显式说出并入档：认知边界的诚实声明是问对的合法起点，不是失败
诘问针对具体答案而非具体人格：检判标准是'这个回答还剩多少'，不是'这个人还剩多少'
对话全程留录：让后来者能重走这场问对，如同《论语》《对话篇》之于后世
process_en: For any key judgment, construct the strongest cross-examination before allowing it to stand; conclusions that never faced adversarial questioning may not enter decisions
Say 'I do not know' explicitly and file it: an honest declaration of cognitive limits is the legitimate opening of inquiry, not its failure
Direct the interrogation at the answer, never the person: the measure is 'how much of this reply survives', not 'how much of this person survives'
Record the dialogue in full so latercomers can re-walk it, as the Analects and the Dialogues did for posterity
representative_cases_zh: 颜渊问仁（颜渊曰：请问其目——追问到可操作细则为止），孔子'为仁由己'的答问链：结论随对话者水平递进而深化，体现'因材施教'的对话分层
《美诺篇》奴隶童子几何实验：苏格拉底不授答案，只以连环追问让童子自己'再发现'正方形倍积——证明知识可被问出而非灌输
反面警示：苏格拉底的诘问法在《游叙弗伦》等篇中常把对话者逼入'无路可走'（aporia）而未交付建设性出路——纯破坏性诘问会耗尽对话者信任，使方法无法在组织中规模化。教训：诘问必须与建设性重构配对。
反面警示：《论语》部分章句为弟子不同流派整理层累而成，对话的'现场性'已被编辑——对话录本身会成为新的权威文本，反过来压制再问对。教训：对话录须标注编辑谱系，防止记录反噬方法。
反面警示：孔子'叩其两端'依赖对话者已有的诚意与素养；面对专断者（如'不可与言而与之言'）该方法失效——诘合法对对手方有资质门槛，越界使用会被反噬为修辞操纵。教训：先评估对手方的可诘性，再决定是否进入问对。
representative_cases_en: Yan Yuan asked about ren, pressing ('May I ask for the particulars?') until the answer reached operational detail — the chain shows conclusions deepening with the interlocutor's level, the dialogue-layering of teaching by aptitude

The slave-boy geometry experiment in the Meno: Socrates gives no answers, only chained questions through which the boy re-derives the doubling of the square — evidence that knowledge can be questioned out rather than poured in

Cautionary: in the Euthyphro and elsewhere Socrates' elenchus often drives the interlocutor into aporia with no constructive exit — purely destructive questioning exhausts the interlocutor's trust and makes the method unscalable in an organization. Lesson: pair interrogation with constructive reconstruction.

Cautionary: some Analects passages are layered compilations by different disciple schools; the 'liveness' of the dialogue is already edited — the dialogue record itself becomes a new authority that suppresses re-questioning. Lesson: mark the editorial genealogy of records lest the record devour the method.

Cautionary: Confucius' 'knocking on both ends' presupposes good faith and cultivation in the interlocutor; faced with the arbitrary ('do not speak with one who cannot be spoken with'), the method fails. Lesson: assess the counterpart's questionability before entering the dialogue.
modern_applications_zh: 组织决策会议以'最强反方'席位制度化：重大结论须在被专职诘问后才能过会
辅导与教练行业：苏格拉底式提问法（Socratic questioning）成为认知行为疗法与高管教练的核心工具
教育中的'探究式学习'：以问题链替代灌输链，把'再发现'设计进课程
modern_applications_en: Institutionalize a 'strongest opposition' seat in decision meetings: major conclusions pass only after dedicated cross-examination
Coaching and therapy: Socratic questioning is a core instrument of cognitive-behavioral therapy and executive coaching
Inquiry-based learning: question chains replace lecture chains, designing 're-discovery' into the curriculum
modes.key_quote_zh: '学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆'与'未经省察的人生不值得过'——东西方在同一轴心把'不省察'判为同一罪。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Learning without thought is labour lost; thought without learning is perilous' meets 'the unexamined life is not worth living' — two civilizations, one Axial-Age verdict on the unexamined.

modes.name_en: The Definitional Vise: Squeezing a Concept Until It Confesses
modes.definition_zh: 对核心概念拒绝默认语义，用连环定义逼挤出其真实边界。方法论签名有四：其一，以'X是什么'开场——苏格拉底每一篇对话几乎都从'什么是正义/虔诚/勇敢'的定义请求开始，孔子论仁亦必先令弟子自陈其解（《论语》'克己复礼为仁''己欲立而立人'诸答皆随问者而异）；其二，以反例施压——每当对话者给出定义，立即寻找满足定义却明显不合直觉的边缘案例，迫使其修订；其三，接受逐步逼近——定义被推翻不是失败而是进展，每轮修订都把概念边界向真实用法收拢；其四，容忍不可完成——两人都清楚定义可能永无终局（苏格拉底常以aporia收场，孔子言'仁'从不给终判），方法的价值在于挤压过程本身校准了共同体的用法。这一模式把概念分析从词典式查阅改写为对抗性迭代工程。
modes.definition_en: Refuse default semantics for a core concept and squeeze its real boundary through chained definition. Four signatures. First, open with 'what is X': nearly every Socratic dialogue begins with a request to define justice, piety, or courage; Confucius' answers on ren likewise vary with each questioner ('restrain self and return to ritual is ren'; 'wishing to stand oneself, help others stand'). Second, press with counterexamples: whenever a definition is offered, immediately seek a borderline case that satisfies it yet offends intuition, forcing revision. Third, accept approximation: a definition overturned is progress, not failure — each round pulls the concept's boundary closer to real usage. Fourth, tolerate incompletion: both knew definition may never terminate (Socrates often ends in aporia; Confucius never issues a final verdict on ren); the method's value is that the squeezing itself calibrates the community's usage. The mode rewrites conceptual analysis from dictionary lookup into adversarial iteration engineering.
modes.source_chapter: 《理想国》卷一'正义是什么'的连环推翻；柏拉图《游叙弗伦》'虔诚是什么'；《论语·颜渊》十二弟子问仁异答
process_zh: 对组织最核心的词（'质量''风险''完成'）禁止默认语义，立项先做定义轮
每个定义给三个边缘反例压力测试，通过才允许进入指标体系
把被推翻的定义存档为'边界发现'，而非当作争论失败
接受定义永不终结：以迭代版本号管理概念，替代一次性立法
process_en: Ban default semantics for an organization's core words ('quality', 'risk', 'done'); every project opens with a definition round
Stress-test each definition with three borderline counterexamples before it may enter the metrics system
Archive overturned definitions as 'boundary discoveries', not as lost arguments
Accept that definition never ends: manage concepts by version number instead of one-shot legislation
representative_cases_zh: 苏格拉底在《理想国》卷一中连破克法洛斯'有债必还'、波勒玛霍斯'各得其宜'、色拉叙马霍斯'强者的利益'三重定义——每轮以一个反例即告崩溃，逼出'正义是灵魂的健康'的更深命题
孔子对'仁'的十余种异答：对颜渊说克己复礼，对仲弓说敬恕，对司马牛说'其言也讱'——同一概念随对话者的短板而重新定义，定义即处方
反面警示：色拉叙马霍斯在第一卷被逼挤后愤而退出论辩——定义逼挤若不修复对手的参与意愿，会把诘问变成逐客。教训：逼挤须配修复动作，如确认对手立场中的有效内核。
反面警示：《美诺篇》以'回忆说'给定义逼挤兜底，但该本体论假设（灵魂前在）并不成立——方法成功不证其配套形而上学成立，捆绑输出会让方法的信用被错误的附属理论透支。教训：方法与配套理论分开交付。
反面警示：现代企业把'定义逼挤'僵化为需求文档仪式后，迭代停止、文档成为新权威——方法的对抗性消失，只剩形式。教训：定义轮须绑定真实冲突（两个部门对'完成'的实际分歧），无冲突则不召开。
representative_cases_en: In Book I of the Republic Socrates demolishes in turn Cephalus' 'repay debts', Polemarchus' 'give each his due', and Thrasymachus' 'the strong's advantage' — each collapsing on a single counterexample, forcing the deeper claim that justice is the health of the soul

Confucius' dozen differing answers on ren: to Yan Yuan 'restrain self and return to ritual', to Zhonggong 'respect and forbearance', to Sima Niu 'be slow of speech' — the same concept re-defined per the questioner's deficiency; definition as prescription

Cautionary: Thrasymachus, squeezed in Book I, storms out of the argument — without repairing the opponent's will to participate, definitional vise turns interrogation into eviction. Lesson: pair squeezing with repair, e.g. confirming the valid kernel in the opponent's position.

Cautionary: the Meno props definition-squeezing on the theory of recollection, whose ontology (the pre-existent soul) does not hold — a method's success does not prove its companion metaphysics; bundled delivery lets an erroneous rider overdraw the method's credit. Lesson: ship method and companion theory separately.

Cautionary: modern firms ritualize the definitional round into requirements-ceremony; iteration stops and the document becomes the new authority — the adversarial edge dies, leaving only form. Lesson: bind each definition round to a real conflict (two departments' actual dispute over 'done'); no conflict, no round.
modern_applications_zh: Agile teams' ritual 'definition of done' fights scope drift by forcing a renegotiated boundary each sprint
Legal drafting: statutory definitions refined through litigation counterexamples across precedents
Product taxonomy work: category boundaries squeezed against edge cases before cataloging at scale
modern_applications_en: Agile's 'definition of done' fights scope drift by forcing renegotiated boundaries every sprint
Statutory legal definitions refined through litigation counterexamples across precedent chains
Product taxonomies: category boundaries squeezed against edge cases before large-scale cataloging
modes.key_quote_zh: '吾道一以贯之'与'未经定义的美德即盲目的美德'——共同拒绝让核心概念在含混中运行。
modes.key_quote_en: 'My way is threaded by one thread' and 'virtue unexamined is virtue unowned' — both refuse to run core concepts on blurred semantics.

modes.name_en: The Turn-Inward: Treating the Self as the First Laboratory
modes.definition_zh: 在要求世界之前先以同一标准检验自身，把'我'设为方法的第一台实验设备。方法论签名有四：其一，归因内向优先——孔子'君子求诸己，小人求诸人'、曾子'吾日三省吾身'，苏格拉底德尔斐神庙'认识你自己'的终身执行，两者都把'向外追责'改判为'向内取证'；其二，以行为证，不以言证——苏格拉底面对死刑拒绝逃亡以证其对法律的承诺，孔子'其身正，不令而行'，论断的最终证据是论断者本人的生活；其三，自察有工具——曾子三省（为人谋而不忠乎？与朋友交而不信乎？传不习乎？）与苏格拉底的省察诘问都提供了可重复的自问清单，使内省从情绪活动变为程序活动；其四，边界在于不自虐——两人都区分省察与自我惩罚：省察指向改进行动，不指向道德羞辱。这一模式把伦理学从'评判他人'的武器库改写为'校准自己'的操作台。
modes.definition_en: Before demanding from the world, test yourself by the same standard — make the self the method's first laboratory. Four signatures. First, inward attribution as default: Confucius' 'the gentleman seeks it in himself; the petty man seeks it in others' and Zengzi's 'daily triple self-examination', alongside Socrates' lifelong execution of Delphi's 'know thyself' — both re-classify outward blame as inward evidence-gathering. Second, prove by living, not saying: Socrates refusing escape to honor his covenant with the laws under a death sentence; Confucius' 'when one's own conduct is upright, things get done without orders' — the final evidence for a claim is the claimant's own life. Third, self-examination needs instruments: Zengzi's three questions and Socrates' examined-life interrogation both supply repeatable self-questioning checklists, turning introspection from an emotional event into a procedural one. Fourth, the boundary is not self-torture: both distinguish examination from self-punishment — examination aims at improved action, not moral humiliation. The mode rewrites ethics from an armory for judging others into a workbench for calibrating oneself.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语·学而》曾子三省、《宪问》'君子求诸己'；柏拉图《申辩篇》29d-30b 省察使命、《克里同篇》拒逃
process_zh: 复盘从'谁的错'改判为'我方哪一环节可改进'：先穷尽内部变量再谈外部变量
把自省写为固定清单（如三省式三问），周期执行并留档，杜绝'想起来才省'
重大主张先在自己身上试点：主张者不做第一个受益者时无权主张
给自察设止损边界：指向行动改进即止，不进入道德羞辱循环
process_en: Re-classify every retrospective from 'whose fault' to 'which of our steps could improve': exhaust internal variables before external ones
Write self-examination as a fixed checklist (a three-question litany), executed on schedule and archived — no 'when remembered' reviews
Pilot every major claim on yourself first: a claimant who is not the first beneficiary has no standing to claim
Set a stop-loss boundary for self-examination: stop at actionable improvement, never enter the humiliation loop
representative_cases_zh: 苏格拉底在《克里同篇》拒绝越狱：逃亡会使他毕生主张的'法律高于私怨'失效——以生命为实验设备验证自己的命题，死亡是实验的最后一组数据
曾子'日三省吾身'把修身降为每日可执行的三个问题，使儒家的道德工程在两千五百年前就获得了'持续集成'结构
反面警示：明清礼教把'反求诸己'异化为对弱者（尤其女性）的单向道德压榨——内向方法一旦由权力单向定义'谁的己'，就退化为规训。教训：反求诸己必须双向对称，上位者先省。
反面警示：苏格拉底的自省以'神谕'为终极背书，其后学将'认识你自己'教条化，自省沦为自我说服的仪式。教训：自察工具须保留可被再诘问的开放性，防止清单本身成为新的不容置疑。
反面警示：孔子后学把'其身正'推向'以德治代替制度'，忽视'身正'的不可验证性与规模局限——个人实验设备无法替代组织级的制度校验。教训：以身作则是必要条件，不是充分条件。
representative_cases_en: Socrates in the Crito refusing escape: flight would falsify his lifelong thesis that law outranks private grievance — using his life as the experimental apparatus, death the final data point
Zengzi's daily triple self-examination reduces cultivation to three executable questions a day, giving Confucian moral engineering a continuous-integration structure twenty-five centuries early

Cautionary: Ming-Qing orthodoxy twisted 'turn inward' into one-way moral extortion of the weak (women above all) — once power defines whose 'self' must examine itself, the inward method degrades into discipline. Lesson: the turn inward must be bidirectionally symmetric; superiors examine first.

Cautionary: Socrates' self-examination leaned on the oracle's ultimate endorsement; later schools dogmatized 'know thyself' into a ritual of self-persuasion. Lesson: keep self-examination instruments open to re-questioning lest the checklist become the new unquestionable.

Cautionary: Confucius' successors pushed 'upright conduct' toward rule-by-virtue replacing institutions, ignoring that personal conduct is unverifiable at scale — one person's lab bench cannot substitute organization-level institutional verification. Lesson: leading by example is necessary, never sufficient.
modern_applications_zh: 现代复盘文化（blameless postmortem）把工程事故审查从追责改判为流程取证，与'君子求诸己'同构
认知行为疗法（CBT）以结构化自问清单把内省程序化，继承'三省'的工具化路径
领导力中的'先试点于己'：主张裁员的总监先在自己团队执行，验证主张成本
modern_applications_en: Blameless postmortems re-classify incident review from blame to process forensics — the engineering isomorph of 'the gentleman seeks it in himself'
Cognitive-behavioral therapy proceduralizes introspection through structured self-questioning checklists, extending Zengzi's instrumentation
'Pilot on yourself first' in leadership: the director advocating layoffs runs them on her own team first, pricing the claim
modes.key_quote_zh: '吾日三省吾身'与'认识你自己'——轴心时代东西方同时发明了把'我'设为实验设备的方法。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Daily I examine myself on three counts' and 'know thyself' — the Axial Age simultaneously invented the self as laboratory, East and West.

modes.name_en: The Adaptive-Dosage Method: Same Truth, Different Prescriptions
modes.definition_zh: 同一真理对不同对象给出不同剂量与切入角，把'教什么'从内容问题改写为诊断问题。方法论签名有四：其一，先诊断后开方——孔子对同一'仁'字按弟子短板各异其答，苏格拉底按对话者职业（将军、祭司、匠人）选择诘问素材；其二，以问代授——诊断通过提问完成（《论语》几乎每章以问开头，《对话篇》以诘问推进），教者先暴露学习者的真实结构再决定介入深度；其三，剂量控制——'不愤不启，不悱不发'：介入时机以学习者自身的困惑积累为准，过早给出即浪费；其四，举一隅不以三隅反则不复——学习者未完成迁移时不继续投喂，把'未准备好'显式承认。这一模式与 M-CC-002 定义逼挤互为表里：逼挤暴露结构，施教按结构配方。它把教学从广播模型改写为配药模型。
modes.definition_en: Deliver the same truth in different doses and angles per recipient — rewrite 'what to teach' from a content question into a diagnostic one. Four signatures. First, diagnose before prescribing: Confucius varied his answers on ren by each disciple's deficiency; Socrates chose interrogation material by the interlocutor's profession (general, priest, craftsman). Second, question instead of lecture: diagnosis runs through questioning (nearly every Analects chapter opens with a question; the Dialogues advance by cross-examination) — the teacher first exposes the learner's real structure, then decides intervention depth. Third, dosage control: 'I do not open up until the mind is agitated, nor supply words until the tongue stumbles' — timing keyed to the learner's own accumulated perplexity; premature answers are wasted. Fourth, stop on failed transfer: 'when I hold up one corner and he cannot return with three, I do not repeat' — unpreparedness explicitly acknowledged. The mode is the twin of M-CC-002: squeezing exposes structure, teaching prescribes by structure. It rewrites teaching from broadcast into pharmacy.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语·雍也》'中人以上可以语上'；《先进》'求也退故进之，由也兼人故退之'；柏拉图《美诺篇》按童子已有几何直觉设计追问链
process_zh: 先以问题暴露学习者的真实结构，再决定教的内容与顺序
介入时机绑定学习者自身的困惑积累：未到'愤悱'不给答案
对未完成迁移者停止投喂并显式承认'未准备好'，不以进度掩盖
同一原则按对象短板重新表述：定义即处方，一人一方
process_en: Expose the learner's real structure through questions first; decide content and order only after
Bind intervention timing to the learner's own accumulated perplexity: no answers before the mind is agitated
Stop feeding on failed transfer and explicitly mark 'not ready', never masking with schedule pressure
Re-state the same principle per the recipient's deficiency: definition as prescription, one formula per person
representative_cases_zh: 孔子对子路与冉有同一问'闻斯行诸'给出相反答案（'求也退故进之，由也兼人故退之'）——《论语·先进》最锋利的'因材施教'实证：原则恒定，剂量相反
苏格拉底在《拉凯斯篇》借两位将军论'勇敢'，选将军熟悉的战场案例作诘问素材——对话者的专业词汇是入口，不熟悉抽象术语的对话者不会被'正义的定义'直接击中
反面警示：孔子对樊迟问稼的冷遇（'吾不如老农'）常被引为'因材'的失败案例——诊断有价值观局限：教师只对'他认为重要的'短板开方，学习者自己的目标会被降格。教训：因材施教须以学习者目标为药引，而非教者目标。
反面警示：现代'个性化学习'平台把因材施教降级为难度调节算法——只调剂量不换视角，诊断维度单一化。教训：真正的'材'包括动机、语境与知识结构三轴，单轴自适应是伪个性化。
反面警示：柏拉图学园后期对不具数学资质者设门槛（《理想国》卷七数学预备论），把'因材'变成'筛选'——方法的诊断面转向淘汰面后，教育从配药退化为分拣。教训：诊断用于配药时是服务，用于淘汰时是暴力。
representative_cases_en: Confucius giving Zilu and Ran You opposite answers to the same 'act on what one hears?' ('Ran is diffident, so I urged him on; Zilu overreaches, so I held him back') — the Analects' sharpest proof: principle constant, dosage inverted
Socrates in the Laches using battlefield cases familiar to two generals as interrogation material — the interlocutor's professional vocabulary is the entrance; abstract definitions would not land

Cautionary: Confucius' cold answer to Fan Chi on farming ('I am not as good as a farmer') is often cited as adaptive teaching failing — diagnosis carries the teacher's value hierarchy: prescriptions target deficiencies the teacher ranks important, while the learner's own goals get demoted. Lesson: adaptive dosage must take the learner's goal as the solvent, not the teacher's.

Cautionary: modern adaptive-learning platforms downgrade the method to difficulty-tuning algorithms — dose adjusted, angle never changed, diagnostics one-dimensional. Lesson: real 'aptitude' spans motivation, context, and knowledge structure; single-axis adaptation is pseudo-personalization.

Cautionary: the later Academy's mathematical prerequisites (Republic VII) turned 'by aptitude' into 'by selection' — once diagnosis faces淘汰, education degrades from pharmacy to sorting. Lesson: diagnosis that prescribes is a service; diagnosis that eliminates is violence.
modern_applications_zh: K-12分层作业与临床教育的'最近发展区'教学：先测当前结构再定介入剂量
咨询行业按客户组织成熟度同一框架不同切入：诊断问卷先行，方案一人一方
教练技术以提问链替代建议链，等客户自身困惑积累到'愤悱'再给反馈
modern_applications_en: Tiered assignments and ZPD-based clinical teaching: measure current structure, then dose the intervention
Consulting applies one framework at different entry angles by client maturity: diagnostic survey first, one prescription per client
Executive coaching replaces advice chains with question chains, delivering feedback only when the client's own perplexity has accumulated
modes.key_quote_zh: '求也退故进之，由也兼人故退之'与按将军论勇敢——真理恒定，处方随人。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Urged on the diffident, held back the headstrong' and generals debating courage — truth constant, prescription by person.

modes.name_en: The Lineage-Community Method: Institutions That Outlive the Teacher
modes.definition_zh: 两人皆无著作而皆有学派：以共同体为知识的存储介质，以师徒制为传播协议。方法论签名有四：其一，人即文本——苏格拉底一字不写、孔子'述而不作'，知识全部承载于受过训练的人，死亡风险由冗余人数对冲（七十弟子/学园世代）；其二，记录即二度创作——弟子整理对话（《论语》曾门、《对话篇》柏拉图）必然带编辑立场，共同体内部公开承认这一层（'记'与'作'的区分）；其三，世代接力——柏拉图学园延续近千年，孔门传经八代而至秦火，师徒制设计了'下一代接棒'的角色分工而非一次性传人；其四，以行证派——学派的生命力最终由其成员的公共行为背书（苏格拉底之死使柏拉图执笔，孔门弟子庐墓三年）。这一模式把知识管理从文档工程改写为共同体工程：文档会腐烂，训练有素的人会繁殖。
modes.definition_en: Both men wrote nothing yet both founded schools: the community as knowledge's storage medium, master-disciple lineage as transmission protocol. Four signatures. First, persons as texts: knowledge resides entirely in trained people, its mortality hedged by headcount redundancy (seventy disciples; generations of the Academy). Second, recording as second authorship: disciples' compilations (Zengzi's school for the Analects, Plato's Dialogues) necessarily carry editorial positions — the community openly acknowledges this layer (the 'transmit/compose' distinction). Third, generational relay: the Academy lasted nearly a millennium; the Confucian school passed its canon through eight generations to the Qin burning — lineage design assigns roles to 'the next carrier' rather than a one-time heir. Fourth, the school proven by conduct: a lineage's vitality is ultimately underwritten by its members' public acts (Socrates' death made Plato write; the disciples mourned Confucius three years by his grave). The mode rewrites knowledge management from document engineering into community engineering: documents rot; trained people reproduce.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语》成书于曾子门人；柏拉图学园（前387-公元529）近千年传承；孔门七十子后学传经谱系
process_zh: 核心知识以'训练人'为主存储、'文档'为辅助校验，不倒置
承认记录即编辑：整理者立场显式署名，版本谱系随文本公开
为关键角色预设'下一代接棒人'，传承按世代设计而非按事件
学派的最终背书是成员的公共行为：把行为准则写入共同体的日常
process_en: Store core knowledge primarily in trained people, with documents as auxiliary verification — never inverted
Acknowledge that recording is editing: compilers sign explicitly, version genealogy travels with the text
Pre-designate the next carrier for every key role; inheritance is generational, not event-driven
A school's ultimate endorsement is its members' public conduct: write conduct norms into the community's daily practice
representative_cases_zh: 苏格拉底之死（前399）直接触发柏拉图创办学园并以对话篇对抗智者派的文字市场——一个共同体的最大危机成为其制度化起点，'殉道者叙事'成为学派最强的传播资产
《论语》由曾子一系整理定型而非孔子自著，孔门各派（子游、子夏、仲弓）各自传经——承认编辑层反而使文本在派系竞争中幸存：每派都有保存经典的动力
反面警示：孔门后学分化为八儒（'儒分为八'），为争夺'正宗'互相攻讦，传承共同体退化为宗派竞争——共同体的存续目标压倒知识目标后，传承质量随内耗下降。教训：共同体须为'再诘问权'立宪，防正宗垄断。
反面警示：柏拉图学园后期转向数学与怀疑论，'苏格拉底'在后世对话篇中沦为柏拉图观点的传声筒——传承者署名权过大时，源头思想在两代内即被改写。教训：记录者与被记录者须有对抗性核对机制。
反面警示：苏格拉底不著书导致其思想完全依赖柏拉图转译，'历史苏格拉底'（Socratic problem）至今不可考——单一记录者即单点故障，共同体冗余不足时知识被一个编辑者垄断。教训：人即文本须以'多记录者冗余'为前提。
representative_cases_en: Socrates' execution (399 BC) directly triggered Plato's founding of the Academy and the Dialogues against the Sophists' text market — the community's greatest crisis became its institutional origin, martyr narrative its strongest transmission asset

The Analects was redacted by Zengzi's line, not authored by Confucius, while rival Confucian schools (Ziyou, Zixia, Zhonggong) each transmitted the canon — acknowledging the editorial layer let the text survive factional competition: every faction had a motive to preserve it

Cautionary: the school split into 'eight branches of Confucianism' warring over orthodoxy — once communal survival outranks the knowledge goal, transmission quality decays with infighting. Lesson: charter the 'right to re-question' constitutionally against orthodoxy monopolies.

Cautionary: the late Academy's turn to mathematics and skepticism left 'Socrates' in later dialogues a mouthpiece for Plato — when the recorder's authorial weight exceeds the recorded, source thought is rewritten within two generations. Lesson: recorder and recorded need adversarial cross-checking.

Cautionary: Socrates' refusal to write made his thought wholly dependent on Plato's translation — the 'historical Socrates' remains unknowable (the Socratic problem). A single recorder is a single point of failure; person-as-text requires multi-recorder redundancy.
modern_applications_zh: 核心工程知识以'带训骨干'为主载体，配合轮岗与多师傅制对冲单点失传
开源社区的'maintainer 接力'：关键仓库预设下一代维护者与署名规范
企业口述史项目：承认编辑立场并标注访谈谱系，防止'官方史'垄断
modern_applications_en: Core engineering knowledge carried primarily in trained staff, hedged by rotation and multi-mentor pairing against single-point loss
Open-source maintainer relay: key repositories pre-designate successors and authorship norms
Corporate oral-history programs: editorial stance acknowledged and interview genealogies marked, preventing one official history
modes.key_quote_zh: '述而不作'与一字不写却千年学统——两人把'人'做成了最耐久的存储介质。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Transmit, not compose' and writing nothing yet founding a millennium of schools — both turned persons into the most durable storage medium.

modes.name_en: The Dual-Rail Order: Ritual and Law as Two Social Kernels
modes.definition_zh: 苏格拉底以个人之死为'法律至上'作终极证明，孔子以'克己复礼'为'规范内化'作终极证明——两种秩序内核在同一世纪被各自推到极限。方法论签名有四：其一，规范的两种安装路径——外置强制（法：违约即罚，苏格拉底《克里同》'即便不公也须服从判决'）与内置自觉（礼：'为仁由己'，规范安装在欲望之前）；其二，对越轨的不同处置——法的处置是惩罚，礼的处置是羞感（'知耻近乎勇'），后者成本更低但依赖共同体监督密度；其三，两轨各自的失效面——法在执行者腐败时失效，礼在共同体瓦解时失效，故两人各自补课：苏格拉底建学园训练'哲学王'以修复执行者，孔子删述六经以重建共同体记忆；其四，个人代价的锚定作用——苏格拉底以身殉法、孔子'知其不可而为之'，秩序命题的信用由创立者的不可逆损失抵押。这一模式把制度设计从单内核改写为双内核互备。
modes.definition_en: Socrates proved 'law supreme' with his own death; Confucius proved 'norm internalization' with 'restrain self, return to ritual' — two order-kernels each driven to the limit in the same century. Four signatures. First, two install paths for norms: external enforcement (law — breach is punished; in the Crito, obey the verdict even unjust) versus internal awakening (ritual — 'becoming ren depends on oneself'; the norm is installed upstream of desire). Second, divergent handling of deviation: law punishes, ritual shames ('knowing shame is near courage') — cheaper, but dependent on community surveillance density. Third, each rail's failure surface: law fails when executors are corrupt, ritual fails when the community dissolves — so each man patched the other's rail: Socrates built the Academy to repair the executors, Confucius edited the Six Classics to rebuild communal memory. Fourth, the anchoring power of personal cost: Socrates dying for law, Confucius 'doing what he knows is hopeless' — the credibility of an order-thesis is collateralized by its founder's irreversible loss. The mode rewrites institutional design from single-kernel to dual-kernel mutual backup.
modes.source_chapter: 《克里同篇》'法律的声音'、《申辩篇》守法与良知冲突；《论语·颜渊》'克己复礼为仁'、《为政》'道之以德齐之以礼……有耻且格'
process_zh: 制度设计双内核并装：外置强制（罚）与内置自觉（耻/荣誉），任一内核不可单独承载全部秩序
为两轨各写失效面预案：法轨预设执行者腐败场景，礼轨预设共同体瓦解场景
秩序命题须由创立者的不可逆损失抵押：规则制定者第一个受规则约束并公开承受
越轨处置优先用羞感与恢复，惩罚作为最后手段——降低秩序运行成本
process_en: Install dual kernels: external enforcement (penalty) and internal awakening (shame/honor); neither kernel alone can carry the whole order
Write failure-surface contingencies for each rail: law rail presupposes corrupt-executor scenarios, ritual rail presupposes community-dissolution scenarios
Collateralize an order-thesis with the founder's irreversible loss: rule-makers bound first, publicly bearing the rule
Prefer shame and restoration over punishment for deviations — penalty as last resort, lowering the order's running cost
representative_cases_zh: 苏格拉底《克里同篇》拒逃：越狱将摧毁'法律优先于私怨'的整个命题——他区分'遵守不公判决'与'服从法律程序'，以死维护程序信用而非判决正义性
孔子'道之以政，齐之以刑，民免而无耻；道之以德，齐之以礼，有耻且格'——先秦最清晰的制度成本分析：刑罚只能让'免'（侥幸躲避），礼让'格'（内在归正），前者维持成本永续、后者一次性安装
反面警示：柏拉图《理想国》'高贵的谎言'（金银铜铁神话）用礼的'内化'之名行愚民之实——内置自觉被设计为可操纵的灌输时，礼轨成为最深的暴政。教训：内化必须是可被诘问的真信，不是植入。
反面警示：汉以后'礼法合一'把儒家礼教写入律令（'春秋决狱'），两轨互备退化为两轨互噬——礼的道德预期抬高法的惩罚尺度（'不孝'入刑）。教训：双轨须保持判据分离，合流即双轨皆失。
反面警示：苏格拉底的守法绝对主义被现代批判为对恶法的无条件服务（如'守法即正当'的辩护）——法轨缺乏'良法判据'时，殉法从锚点退化为同谋。教训：法律至上命题须内嵌'恶法可诉'的更新通道。
representative_cases_en: Socrates in the Crito: escape would destroy the whole thesis that law outranks private grievance — he distinguishes 'obeying an unjust verdict' from 'obeying legal process', dying to protect procedural credit, not the verdict's justice

Confucius: 'govern by edicts and penalties and people evade without shame; govern by virtue and ritual and they have shame and reform' — pre-Qin's clearest institutional cost analysis: penalties buy evasion ('mian'), ritual installs internal correction ('ge'), the former's cost is perpetual, the latter a one-time install

Cautionary: Plato's 'noble lie' (gold-silver-bronze myth) smuggles indoctrination under the banner of internalization — when the inward kernel is designed as manipulable implantation, the ritual rail becomes the deepest tyranny. Lesson: internalization must be genuine, questionable belief — never implantation.

Cautionary: post-Han 'merger of ritual and law' (Chunqiu adjudication) let the two rails devour each other — moral expectations inflated penal severity (filial impiety criminalized). Lesson: keep the rails' criteria separate; merger loses both.

Cautionary: Socrates' legal absolutism is criticized as unconditional service to bad law ('legality equals legitimacy') — without a 'good-law criterion', dying for law degrades from anchor to accomplice. Lesson: the law-supremacy thesis needs a built-in channel for challenging unjust law.
modern_applications_zh: 组织合规双轨：纪律处罚与荣誉文化并行，任一单独使用都会被绕过
共同体规范的'羞感设计'：开源社区以公开评审与署名信用替代部分许可证诉讼
'规则制定者第一个受约束'：高管薪酬公开化、高管先用新制度
modern_applications_en: Dual-rail corporate compliance: discipline and honor culture run in parallel; either alone gets circumvented
Shame-based norm design in communities: open review and attribution credit replacing parts of license litigation
'Rule-makers bound first': executive pay transparency and executives onboarding new policies on themselves
modes.key_quote_zh: '克己复礼'与《克里同》拒逃——一个把规范装进心里，一个以死为法律作保。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Restrain self, return to ritual' and the Crito's refusal — one installs norms in the heart, the other bonds law with his life.

modes.name_en: Virtue-as-Knowledge: Ethics Run as an Epistemic Program
modes.definition_zh: 两人共同的核心等式：道德失败是认知失败——'知'与'德'不是两个领域而是一个。方法论签名有四：其一，无人自愿作恶——苏格拉底'无人明知善而作恶'，孔子'知仁者鲜'与'好仁不好学，其蔽也愚'，两者都把恶归因于认知残缺而非意志腐坏；其二，德目须可定义、可教——若勇敢即知识，则勇敢可教，美诺悖论（德能否教）在两人处都是肯定倾向；其三，知识须结构化——孔子'博学于文，约之以礼'的博约结构、苏格拉底从具体德目逼向单一'美德整体'，都拒绝把道德留为散点格言；其四，闭环在行为验证——'知'的最终检验仍是生活（'听其言而观其行'），知识论与伦理学共用一套验证协议。这一模式把伦理学从规训改写为认知工程：改道德先改认知地图。
modes.definition_en: The shared core equation: moral failure is cognitive failure — 'knowing' and 'virtue' are one field, not two. Four signatures. First, no one does evil knowingly: Socrates' 'no one does wrong willingly'; Confucius' 'few know ren' and 'loving ren without loving learning veils it in folly' — both attribute evil to cognitive deficit, not corrupt will. Second, virtues must be definable and teachable: if courage is knowledge, courage can be taught; the Meno paradox (can virtue be taught?) tends affirmative in both. Third, knowledge must be structured: Confucius' 'broaden in culture, discipline with ritual' (bo-yue) and Socrates' squeeze from particular virtues toward a single unity of virtue both refuse to leave morality as scattered maxims. Fourth, the loop closes in behavioral verification: 'knowing' is finally tested by living ('listen to words and watch conduct') — epistemology and ethics share one verification protocol. The mode rewrites ethics from discipline into cognitive engineering: to change conduct, change the cognitive map.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语·雍也》'知者利仁'、《阳货》六言六蔽；柏拉图《普罗泰戈拉篇》'无人自愿作恶'论证、《美诺篇》德可教
process_zh: 把行为问题先判为认知问题：改造行为前先审计当事人的认知地图（对什么无知、误以为什么知）
培训预算优先投向'德目结构化'：把价值观从格言墙降维成可教、可测、可迭代的课程
对屡犯者先做'知识缺口诊断'再谈惩戒：多数'明知故犯'实为'不知其所以知'
知的验证协议与行统一：任何'已理解'的判定须通过行为证据复核
process_en: Re-classify conduct problems as cognition problems: before behavior change, audit the actor's cognitive map (what they are ignorant of, what they wrongly believe they know)
Prioritize training budgets on structuring virtues: turn value statements from poster walls into teachable, testable, iterable curricula
Diagnose knowledge gaps before punishing repeat offenders: most 'knowing violations' are 'not knowing what knowing requires'
Unify the verification protocol of knowing and doing: any 'understood' verdict must be re-confirmed by behavioral evidence
representative_cases_zh: 苏格拉底《普罗泰戈拉篇》击败'德不可教'论：若德是知识则可教——用'无人自愿作恶'的量尺论证勇气与智慧不可分，被说服者当场放弃'意志败坏论'
孔子'六言六蔽'（《阳货》）：好仁不好学则愚、好知不好学则荡、好信不好学则贼——同一美德缺认知配套即翻转为恶德，是'美德即知识'最紧凑的东方矩阵表述
反面警示：亚里士多德对'美德即知识'的最强反驳——'知而不行'（akrasia，意志薄弱）在经验上真实存在，认知充分者仍会败德。教训：认知是德性的必要非充分条件，方法须预留意志与习惯的第二引擎。
反面警示：宋明理学'存天理灭人欲'把'德即知'推向知识垄断，德性判断权集中于经学解释权——伦理认知工程一旦与权力结合，'无知'成为道德罪名的构建工具。教训：认知工程须防解释权垄断。
反面警示：现代组织把'美德即知识'降为合规培训完课率——知识交付了，行为没变，因为缺了行为验证闭环与情境演练。教训：等式的重心在验证协议，不在课程交付。
representative_cases_en: Socrates in the Protagoras defeating 'virtue cannot be taught': if virtue is knowledge it is teachable — the unity of courage and wisdom argued by the yardstick 'no one does wrong willingly', dissolving the corrupt-will theory on the spot

Confucius' six virtues six veils (Yanghuo): love of ren without learning veils it in folly, love of knowledge without learning in dissipation, love of good faith without learning in harm — the compact Eastern matrix of virtue-as-knowledge: the same virtue without its cognitive complement flips into vice

Cautionary: Aristotle's strongest objection — akrasia (weakness of will) is empirically real; the cognitively sufficient still fail morally. Lesson: cognition is necessary, not sufficient; the method needs a second engine of habit and will.

Cautionary: Neo-Confucian 'preserve heavenly principle, extinguish human desire' pushed virtue-as-knowledge into cognitive monopoly — moral judgment power concentrated in hermeneutic authority. Once cognitive engineering weds power, 'ignorance' becomes a constructed moral indictment. Lesson: guard against interpretive monopoly.

Cautionary: modern organizations degrade the equation into compliance-training completion rates — knowledge delivered, conduct unchanged, missing the behavioral verification loop and situational drills. Lesson: the equation's weight lies in the verification protocol, not course delivery.
modern_applications_zh: 安全工程'违规先查认知'：先审计操作者对风险的地图（护具必要性认知），再谈处分
领导力培训把价值观结构化为情景判断题库并配套行为复核，替代格言式宣讲
习惯科学（habit science）补足'知而不行'：以环境设计与微习惯接驳认知教育的失效面
modern_applications_en: Safety engineering audits the operator's risk cognitive map (why the harness matters) before disciplinary talk
Leadership training structures values into situational-judgment banks with behavioral re-verification, replacing aphorism walls
Habit science patches 'knowing without doing': environment design and micro-habits bridging the failure surface of cognitive education
modes.key_quote_zh: '好仁不好学，其蔽也愚'与'无人自愿作恶'——两个文明在同一处把恶判读为无知。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Loving ren without learning veils it in folly' and 'no one does wrong willingly' — two civilizations reading evil as ignorance at the same point.

modes.name_zh: 述而不作与转译创作法
modes.name_en: Transmit-vs-Compose: The Editor as Second Author
modes.definition_zh: 两人皆'不写'，其思想却经由两种相反的记录策略各自成为世界级文本：孔门弟子辑录言行成《论语》（碎片化、编年体、低干预），柏拉图虚构苏格拉底成《对话篇》（戏剧化、体系化、高干预）。方法论签名有四：其一，记录者自觉选择干预度——辑录派把'忠实'置顶（'子不语怪力乱神'的克制即记录纪律），创作派把'传神'置顶（柏拉图自承中期对话已是自己的哲学）；其二，记录者立场显式化——曾门辑录与柏拉图创作各自暴露其选择性（哪些对话被收录、哪些弟子发言被保留皆是立场）；其三，以文体承接思想的形态——格言体承载可引诵的实践智慧，戏剧体承载可分析的论证结构，文体不是容器而是思想的部分本身；其四，双重署名结构——《论语》题'孔子曰'而编者为佚名弟子，《对话篇》署柏拉图而主角是苏格拉底，'谁在说'与'谁在写'的分离被两人传统各自制度化。这一模式把传播从'复制'改写为'转译工程'。
modes.definition_en: Neither man wrote, yet their thought became world-text through two opposite recording strategies: the disciples' Analects (fragmented, annalistic, low intervention) versus Plato's fictionalized Dialogues (dramatized, systematized, high intervention). Four signatures. First, the recorder consciously chooses intervention level: the compilation school ranks fidelity first (the Analects' restraint — 'the Master did not speak of prodigies, force, disorder, or spirits' — is recording discipline), the composition school ranks vividness first (Plato concedes middle-period dialogues are his own philosophy). Second, the recorder's stance made explicit: what is included, whose speeches survive — each tradition exposes its selectivity. Third, genre as part of the thought itself: aphoristic form carries recitable practical wisdom; dramatic form carries analyzable argument structure — form is not a container but a component of the thought. Fourth, dual-signature structure: 'Confucius said' with anonymous compilers; 'Plato' with Socrates as protagonist — the separation of 'who speaks' from 'who writes' is institutionalized in both traditions. The mode rewrites transmission from copying into translation engineering.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语》辑录与'子不语怪力乱神'；柏拉图第七书信对'无可书写之学'的自陈与《对话篇》的虚构权
process_zh: 知识传播前显式选择干预度：忠实辑录或体系重构，不混用却假装其一
记录者立场写入交付物：选材标准、收录边界随文本公开
按思想的运行形态选文体：需背诵践行的用格言体，需推演检验的用论证体
落实'谁在说/谁在写'双重署名：转译者承担转译责任，不冒充原声
process_en: Choose the intervention level explicitly before transmission: faithful compilation or systematic reconstruction — never blend while claiming one
Write the recorder's stance into the deliverable: selection criteria and inclusion boundaries travel with the text
Match genre to the thought's operating mode: aphorism for what must be memorized and enacted, argument-drama for what must be derived and tested
Institutionalize dual signatures of 'who speaks / who writes': the translator owns the translation, never impersonating the source voice
representative_cases_zh: 《论语》的碎片辑录体反而成为最高强度的传播文本：章句短到可终身携带，弟子发言保留使文本自带多视角，《论语》成为'低干预记录'的工程学胜利
柏拉图在《泰阿泰德》等篇以助产术自喻并承认无法写出'活的知识'，却仍选择戏剧体转译——他清楚代价（体系被误读为苏格拉底原意）并定价了代价，是有意识的转译创作
反面警示：《对话篇》的高干预使'历史苏格拉底'永久不可考，柏拉图署名淹没苏格拉底——转译自由度过高时，源头声纹丢失。教训：高干预转译必须保留源声对照（如早期对话与中期对话分层署名）。
反面警示：《论语》低干预留下大量语境缺失（'《诗》三百……思无邪'的对话场景不明），后世注疏为补语境各自虚构，碎片成为歧义工厂。教训：低干预记录须强制附场景元数据，否则歧义由后人买单。
反面警示：现代企业把'述而不作'当作拒绝文档化的借口，知识留在'人即文本'上随人员流失蒸发——辑录是高投入工程不是默认状态。教训：'不写'必须配'有人记录'的建制，否则等于不传。
representative_cases_en: The Analects' fragment-compilation form became the strongest transmission text ever: chapters short enough to carry for life, disciples' voices retained for built-in multi-perspectivity — an engineering victory of low-intervention recording

Plato self-describes midwifery in the Theaetetus and admits living knowledge cannot be written, yet still chooses dramatic translation — pricing the cost (system misread as Socrates' own voice) consciously; translation-as-composition by design

Cautionary: the Dialogues' high intervention made the historical Socrates permanently unknowable — excessive translational freedom loses the source voiceprint. Lesson: high-intervention translation must keep source-voice contrast (early vs. middle dialogues layering attribution).

Cautionary: the Analects' low intervention left context gaps (dialogue settings for 'The 300 poems... no depraved thoughts' unknown); later commentaries invented their own contexts — fragments became an ambiguity factory. Lesson: low-intervention records must carry scene metadata, or ambiguity is billed to posterity.

Cautionary: modern firms use 'transmit, not compose' as an excuse to skip documentation; knowledge evaporates with staff — compilation is a high-investment engineering effort, not a default state. Lesson: 'not writing' requires an institution of 'someone recording', or it equals not transmitting.
modern_applications_zh: 企业知识库的'口述实录 vs 方法论重构'双轨：访谈原声与重构手册分层署名
会议纪要'低干预'规范：只记发言不记'精神'，场景元数据（议题、在场者）强制附注
技术布道中的戏剧体重构：以虚构案例承载论证结构，署名区隔原声与重构
modern_applications_en: Corporate knowledge bases run dual tracks — verbatim interview records vs. reconstructed methodology handbooks — with layered signatures
Low-intervention minutes norms: record speeches only, mandatory scene metadata (topic, attendees), no 'spirit of the meeting'
Dramatic reconstruction in technical evangelism: fictional cases carrying argument structure, attribution separating source voice from reconstruction
modes.key_quote_zh: '述而不作，信而好古'与柏拉图的戏剧转译——同源思想，两种记录工程，两种文明文本。
modes.key_quote_en: 'I transmit but do not compose' and Plato's dramatic translation — one source, two recording engineers, two civilizational texts.

modes.name_en: The Learn-Examine Loop: Absorption and Testing as One Cycle
modes.definition_zh: 孔子的'学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆'与苏格拉底的'助产术'构成同一循环的东西两端：输入不经检验则成堆积，检验不经输入则成空洞。方法论签名有四：其一，双引擎恒开——'学'（吸收传统、文本、他人经验）与'思'（省察、诘问、重构）不可单独供给，孔子把偏废双方各判一病（罔/殆），苏格拉底把'有学问但不省察'与'空转聪明'都判为伪知识；其二，输入有源——'学'的对象是六艺与文献传统（孔子），是匠人、诗人与对话者的既有确信（苏格拉底），两家的'思'都以真实材料为靶，不思虚空；其三，检验有协议——'举一反三'与诘问反例都是标准化的迁移测试，未通过则回到输入端；其四，循环终身化——'发愤忘食，乐以忘忧，不知老之将至'与苏格拉底临刑仍演练论证，学习循环被设计为不可退出。这一模式把学习从'获取信息'改写为'双引擎循环工程'。
modes.definition_en: Confucius' 'learning without thought is labor lost; thought without learning is perilous' and Socrates' midwifery are the East and West ends of one cycle: input untested becomes hoarding; testing un-fed becomes hollow. Four signatures. First, both engines always on: 'learning' (absorbing tradition, texts, others' experience) and 'examining' (interrogating, cross-questioning, restructuring) cannot run singly — Confucius sentences each neglect to its own disease (bewilderment / peril); Socrates condemns both the erudite-unexamined and the clever-empty to pseudo-knowledge. Second, input has a source: the object of learning is the Six Arts and the textual tradition (Confucius), the existing convictions of craftsmen, poets, interlocutors (Socrates) — both 'examinations' aim at real material, never a vacuum. Third, testing has a protocol: 'return with three corners' and counterexample interrogation are standardized transfer tests; on failure, back to the input end. Fourth, the loop is lifelong: 'so absorbed as to forget food, so joyful as to forget sorrow, unaware old age is coming' and Socrates rehearsing argument on the day of execution — the learning cycle is designed to be inescapable. The mode rewrites learning from information acquisition into dual-engine cycle engineering.
modes.source_chapter: 《论语·为政》'学而不思则罔'、《述而》'举一隅不以三隅反'；柏拉图《泰阿泰德》助产术、《申辩篇》临终论证演练
process_zh: 学习流程强制双段：每一段输入须有对应的省察产出，未省察的输入标记'未消化'
以迁移测试代替复述测试：能对'举一隅'给出'三隅反'才算掌握
把省察绑定真实材料：诘问对象永远是具体文本、案例、既有确信，不做空转反思
学习循环终身化并公开化：把'仍在学'写入身份（苏格拉底之'爱智'），而非阶段性资格
process_en: Make every learning cycle two-phase: each input must yield an examination output; unexamined input is tagged 'undigested'
Replace recall tests with transfer tests: mastery is certified only by 'three corners returned'
Bind examination to real material: the target of interrogation is always a concrete text, case, or conviction — never free-floating reflection
Make the learning loop lifelong and public: write 'still learning' into identity (Socrates' philo-sophia), not a stage-gate credential
representative_cases_zh: 孔子'温故而知新，可以为师矣'：把复习（故）与重构（新）压进同一动作，学思循环被压缩为单步可判定的标准——'能出新'即循环闭合的证据
苏格拉底临刑日仍在《斐多》中演练灵魂不朽论证并劝同狱者继续追问——学习循环对死亡豁免关闭，是'终身化'的极限注脚
反面警示：苏格拉底式'产婆'只出不进，对没有知识储备的对话者（未'受孕'者）无能为力——他自承'不生产知识只接生'，纯检验引擎无输入时熄火。教训：思的引擎须以学的引擎预载，教练对空白领域学员应先供料。
反面警示：孔子'学'以六艺经典为唯一正源，'攻乎异端，斯害也已'被后世读为排斥异见——输入源单一化后，思的检验对象贫瘠化，循环退化为经学复读。教训：输入源必须保持多元，'异端'是检验引擎的燃料不是敌人。
反面警示：现代'终身学习'话语被降格为课程囤积——只开输入引擎，'思'的产出为零，证书即终点。教训：学思互证的判据是产出（新判断、新迁移），不是学时与证书。
representative_cases_en: Confucius' 'reviewing the old and deriving the new — fit to be a teacher': review (old) and reconstruction (new) compressed into one act; 'deriving the new' is the certifiable evidence the loop has closed

Socrates on execution day in the Phaedo still rehearsing the immortality argument and urging his jail companions to keep questioning — the learning loop exempted from death, the limiting footnote of 'lifelong'

Cautionary: the Socratic midwife only delivers, never conceives — powerless before interlocutors with no knowledge in the domain ('not pregnant'); he admitted he produces nothing, only assists. A pure testing engine stalls without input. Lesson: pre-load the examination engine with the learning engine; coaches supply material to novices first.

Cautionary: Confucius' 'learning' took the Six Arts as the sole orthodoxy ('attacking heterodoxy is harmful indeed' as later read) — single-source input starves the testing engine, the loop decays into canonical recitation. Lesson: keep input sources plural; 'heterodoxy' is the testing engine's fuel, not its enemy.

Cautionary: modern 'lifelong learning' degraded into course hoarding — input engine on, examination output zero, certificates as terminus. Lesson: the learn-examine loop is certified by outputs (new judgments, new transfers), not hours and certificates.
modern_applications_zh: 工程团队的'输入配对输出'学习制度：每读完一篇论文/代码须产出反驳或重构，否则不入知识库
组织以'举一反三测试'代替培训完课率：能迁移到新场景才算掌握
个人知识管理的'双账本'：输入账（读了什么）与省察账（改了什么判断）强制配对
modern_applications_en: Engineering teams pair every input with an output: no paper/code enters the knowledge base without a rebuttal or reconstruction
Organizations replace completion-rate metrics with transfer tests: mastered means movable to a new scenario
Personal knowledge management's double ledger: input ledger (what was read) forcibly paired with examination ledger (what judgments changed)
modes.key_quote_zh: '学而不思则罔，思而不学则殆'与助产术——同一循环的两台引擎，缺一台即熄火。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Learning without thought is lost; thought without learning is peril' and midwifery — one cycle, two engines; lose either, the cycle stalls.

modes.name_en: The Axial-Cost Audit: Pricing the Breakthrough Honestly
modes.definition_zh: 两人的突围都标了价，且都由本人支付：苏格拉底饮鸩，孔子惶惶如丧家之犬而道不行。方法论签名有四：其一，创新与既有秩序存在结构性冲突——诘问必然触碰权贵确信（苏格拉底'腐蚀青年'罪），平民教育必然触动贵族垄断（孔子'有教无类'遭世袭贵族排斥），突围的代价不是意外而是设计的必然产物；其二，代价由创立者本人先行承担——两人都不把代价外部化：苏格拉底拒绝学生安排的逃亡，孔子周游列国十四年自食其困，'创始人自付费'使命题可信度与个人风险绑定；其三，代价分期回收——苏格拉底的死在八十年后兑换为学园千年（柏拉图明言这是其执笔动因），孔子的'道不行'在四百年后兑换为汉代国教，突破性投资的回报周期以世代计；其四，代价不对称核算——两人被处死/被放逐的直接成本远小于其思想衍生文明数千年制度变迁的总成本，历史级创新的成本核算必须以千年为分母。这一模式把'思想史的牺牲叙事'改写为'突破性投资的财务模型'。
modes.definition_en: Both men's breakthroughs carried a price, and both paid it personally: Socrates drank the hemlock; Confucius wandered 'like a homeless dog' with his Way unadopted. Four signatures. First, innovation structurally conflicts with the incumbent order — interrogation necessarily touches the powerful's convictions (Socrates' charge of 'corrupting the youth'), mass education necessarily touches aristocratic monopoly (Confucius' 'education without class' repelled by hereditary lords); the cost is not accident but a designed product. Second, the founder pays first, not last: Socrates refusing his students' escape plan, Confucius bearing fourteen years of exile states by state — 'founder pays' binds the thesis's credibility to personal risk. Third, costs amortize across generations: Socrates' death was cashed eighty years later into a millennium of the Academy (Plato named it as his motive to write); Confucius' 'the Way does not prevail' was cashed four hundred years later into the Han state cult — breakthrough investments mature on generational horizons. Fourth, asymmetric accounting: the direct cost (one execution, one exile) is trivial against the total cost of millennia of institutional change their thought induced — civilization-scale innovation must be audited with a millennium as denominator. The mode rewrites the 'martyr narrative' of intellectual history as a financial model of breakthrough investment.
modes.source_chapter: 柏拉图《申辩篇》38a'更美好的死'；柏拉图第七书信自陈执笔动因；《史记·孔子世家》'累累若丧家之狗'与'知其不可而为之'
process_zh: 立项时显式核算'对既有秩序的结构性冒犯'：突围代价写进计划，不当意外处理
突破性主张由主张者自付首批代价：创立者先受规则约束，信用与风险绑定
以世代为回报周期设置预期：突破性投资的估值不用年度报表衡量
对'小代价大衍生'的历史级创新单独建账：直接成本与文明总成本分开核算
process_en: Price the structural offense to the incumbent order at project launch: breakthrough costs enter the plan, never treated as surprises
The claimant pays the first tranche personally: founders bound by their own rules first, credit and risk tied
Set return horizons in generations: breakthrough investments are never valued on annual statements
Ledger civilization-scale innovations separately: direct cost and derived civilizational cost audited apart
representative_cases_zh: 苏格拉底在《申辩篇》拒绝求赦并称'分手的时刻到了，我去死，你们去活，谁的去路好，唯有神知道'——把死刑重新定价为'哲学事业的投资'，代价的会计科目被他当场改写
孔子'知其不可而为之'：明知列国不会采纳仍十四年周游——'不可'的判断与'为之'的选择并列，宣告投资决策不取决于当期成功率，而取决于千年后资产（儒家文明）的贴现值
反面警示：苏格拉底之死的'殉道叙事'被后世过度美化，掩盖了他对民主政体的尖锐敌意与雅典恢复民主后的政治清算背景——代价审计若被叙事接管，会从核算退化为宣传。教训：殉道账目须与政治账目分列，防止牺牲叙事豁免思想中的真实错误。
反面警示：汉代'独尊儒术'把孔子思想的回收兑换为意识形态垄断，'有教无类'的普惠内核被经学门槛反向阉割——后世回报未必是创立者想要的回报，投资的'最终资产'会漂移。教训：代价审计须写明'可接受回报的边界'，防冒名兑现。
反面警示：现代初创文化把'创始人自付代价'浪漫化为'不领薪水+ burnt out'的常态，代价审计被英雄叙事替代——个人牺牲掩盖了结构性定价错误（股权/预算对代价的对冲缺失）。教训：自付代价应是信用抵押，不是定价缺位。
representative_cases_en: Socrates in the Apology refusing to plead for clemency: 'the hour of departure has arrived — I go to die, you to live; which is better, only God knows' — re-pricing the death sentence as an investment in the philosophical project, rewriting its accounting line on the spot

Confucius' 'doing what one knows is hopeless': knowing the states would not adopt him yet wandering fourteen years — the judgment 'hopeless' and the choice 'doing it' side by side, declaring that investment decisions depend not on current success rates but on the discounted value of a millennium-later asset (Confucian civilization)

Cautionary: the martyr narrative of Socrates' death was over-beautified, veiling his sharp hostility to democracy and the political purge context of restored Athens — when narrative takes over the audit, accounting degrades into propaganda. Lesson: keep the martyr ledger and the political ledger separate; sacrifice stories must not exempt real errors in the thought.

Cautionary: Han 'exalting Confucianism alone' cashed the returns into ideological monopoly, gutting the inclusive core of 'education without class' behind classical-erudition gates — later returns may not be the returns the founder wanted; the 'final asset' of an investment drifts. Lesson: the cost audit must state 'acceptable-return boundaries' against counterfeit cashing.

Cautionary: modern startup culture romanticizes 'founder pays' into a norm of no-salary burnout — hero narrative replacing cost accounting, personal sacrifice masking structural mispricing (missing equity/budget hedging of the cost). Lesson: paying personally is collateral for credit, not the absence of a price.
modern_applications_zh: 突破性研发立项的'冒犯预审'：新范式对既有产品线/权责结构的冲击显式估价并预留预算
创始人代价条款：核心团队自付首批成本（降薪、回购承诺）作为对外信用抵押
长期资本对'世代回报'资产的估值方法：用衍生文明/生态总成本而非当期营收做分母
modern_applications_en: Pre-audit the offense in breakthrough R&D: explicit valuation of a new paradigm's shock to incumbent product lines and power structures, with budget reserved
Founder-cost clauses: the core team pays the first tranche (pay cuts, buyback pledges) as external credit collateral
Valuing generational-return assets in long capital: derived-civilization/ecosystem total cost as denominator, not current revenue
modes.key_quote_zh: '知其不可而为之'与'我去死，你们去活'——轴心突围的价格，两人都用本人支付并千年回收。
modes.key_quote_en: 'Doing what one knows is hopeless' and 'I go to die, you to live' — the Axial breakthrough's price, paid in person, cashed across a millennium.
